item.title: Maccelli scores 2 as Maple Leafs beat Oilers 5-2, head into Olympic break with 3 straight wins
item.description: EDMONTON, Alberta (AP) — Matias Maccelli scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs defeated the Edmonton Oilers 5-2 on Tuesday night. Matthew Knies added a goal and an assist for Toronto (27-21-9).

item.title: Son of late dictator Gadhafi is killed in Libya
item.description: CAIRO (AP) — Seif al-Islam Gadhafi, the son and one-time heir apparent of Libya's late dictator Moammar Gadhafi, was killed in the northern African country, Libyan officials said Tuesday.

item.title: Knicks win 7th straight, crush Wizards 132-101
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Karl-Anthony Towns had 19 points and 14 rebounds, and the New York Knicks rolled to their seventh straight victory, 132-101 over the Washington Wizards on Tuesday night.

item.title: Kevin Huerter heads to East-leading Pistons in 4-player, 3-team deal
item.description: The Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons got deeper Tuesday by acquiring Kevin Huerter from the Chicago Bulls as the centerpiece of a four-player, three-team deal.

item.title: Spruce Kings take over first place with road win
item.description: Hesselgrave, Wachtel score a pair in 6-1 win over Langley Rivermen

item.title: Jaylen Brown leads Celtics over Mavs 110-100 despite Flagg's latest record for teenager
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — Jaylen Brown had 33 points and 11 rebounds, and the Boston Celtics beat Dallas 110-100 on Tuesday night, overcoming another stellar showing from Cooper Flagg and handing the Mavericks their season-worst fifth consecutive loss.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe scores 25 in 76ers' 4th straight win, 113-94 over Warriors with Curry sidelined
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Rookie VJ Edgecombe had 25 points, seven rebounds and seven assists, Andre Drummond added 12 points and 11 rebounds, and the Philadelphia 76ers won their fifth straight game, 113-94 on Tuesday night over the Golden State Warriors

item.title: NHL roundup: Olivier's two goals and Merzlikins' shutout power Blue Jackets to sixth straight win
item.description: NEWARK, N.J. (AP) — Mathieu Olivier scored twice in the third period, and Elvis Merzlikins made 23 saves for his first shutout of the season as the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Tuesday night for their sixth straight win.

item.title: Gauthier gets 25th goal and surging Ducks beat Kraken 4-2 to move closer to Pacific Division lead
item.description: ANAHEIM, Calif. (AP) — Cutter Gauthier scored his 25th goal and the Anaheim Ducks defeated the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Tuesday night to win their final game before the Olympic break.
